summary: Alphabet Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of concurrent underwritten public offerings of €9 billion euro-denominated and C$9.5 billion Canadian dollar-denominated senior notes under its existing shelf registration. The notes were issued under a 2016 indenture with The Bank of New York Mellon as trustee. No price per share, premium, or acquisition-related terms are present; this is a routine debt capital markets transaction. The filing does not involve any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. It is a standard note offering disclosure by the issuer.
